Reference is for tiny lower Maicheng narrative placement ONLY, NOT the armored figure or clouds or healthy dragon.
Primary: genuinely terrifying, sinister enraged ASURA DEMON DEITY, three distinct heads and exactly SIX powerful arms, two powerful legs. Colossal exposed dark reddish charcoal skin, huge naked pectorals, deltoids, ribcage and abdominal muscles. Anatomically coherent three pairs of clearly separated shoulders/arms, visible elbow wrist connections and six countable hands. No chest armor, no robes hiding torso, no regular Guan Yu soldier costume, no three ordinary human faces. Nonhuman demonic fanged faces, heavy brutal brows, shadowed eyes, horn-like demonic crown growths, fierce supernatural physique. Only small traces of Guan Yu remain: a windblown white beard on central monstrous face and a small tattered dark-green waist sash. Tasteful armored loincloth covers pelvis. Center head tilted BACK roaring UPWARD to heaven; other heads also enraged. Lower pair fists near waist, middle pair reaching outward with clawlike hands, upper pair bent raised fists; all arms inside safe frame x=130..870 and y=300..1120, no outstretched hands cropped.
Co-primary dragon overhead: huge WOUNDED DEMON GREEN CHINESE DRAGON, powerful head, broken jagged horn, missing scale patches with deep old scar fissures, tattered whiskers and mane, not cute pristine healthy dragon. Its mouth and snout tilted UPWARD roaring toward the same sky as deity. Emerald spectral energy, dark green-black scales, no gore. Head in upper center/right but entirely within x=180..830 y=100..430. Broad thick neck briefly visible and disappearing into shadow.
Air: sparse enormous dark smoky masses, broad smooth wisps and large quiet negative spaces. NO repeated little fluffy cloud lobes, NO dense decorative cloud curls. Background restrained very dark storm blue charcoal, broad green rim-light on muscular silhouette, only a few large continuous green/red spectral energy arcs.
Tiny bottom narrative takes only bottom 12%: distant ruined gate with clearly readable stone characters 麦城, one tiny frail elderly white-bearded mortal Guan Yu in ragged green beside his fallen intact red horse; his damaged crescent glaive has long straight rigid pole and a few battle nicks, no gore. The mortal and horse are VERY SMALL low contrast, atmosphere softened, narrative subordinate to enormous roaring demon and dragon. Stone letters integrated in gate perspective/light, not black sticker.
Premium crisp dramatic anime-fantasy game illustration, exceptionally crisp face muscle hands and dragon head, clean continuous surfaces, broad designed highlights. Strong hierarchy. NO gold dust, sparks, star-speckles, pitting, stippled texture, glitter, random surface luminous dots, bokeh. No weapons in giant's hands. No writing other than 麦城. Preserve safe margins for overlay frame and upper-right nameplate, lower-right passive UI.
